lines.text: BEYOND river Jordan
I am called - 2ce
All my beloved who in transit hath gone
I would with them access to glory
To depart no more forever and ever
Hasten now to the home of love
The sacred book of Jesus tells me now
Angels hear me to my source of joy
And Jesus leads me to heaven.
